notes.summary: Wrote the Test Strategy & Master Test Plan (Doc 04, MTP-TRUMOCRACY v1.0.0, Status In Review), grounded in Doc 02, Doc 05, ADR-001..ADR-014 and the code that actually exists (tools/evm-harness, tools/dep-guard, packages/protocol + its 82 green unit tests, packages/contracts/src). Seven test levels mapped to the ADR-011 topology; differential testing (protocol reference vs deployed contract) named the highest-value suite; a mandatory ZK doctrine where positive tests count for nothing; capability-absence testing as a first-class technique with six stated limits; 16 adversarial suites, one per RISK; a verification method for all 26 NFRs; and 18 OPEN findings of which 7 are Gate-2 blocking.

key_decisions: No Foundry/Hardhat/RPC: tools/evm-harness (solc-js + EthereumJS) is the contract test runner, because offline byte-identical reproduction on a fresh clone is what makes results credible to an outside auditor.
TS-DIFF (packages/protocol reference vs deployed contract) is the highest-value suite; zero divergences is merge-blocking and any divergence is automatically Sev-1.

Harness discipline as flake control: fresh Chain per test (do not rely on snapshot/revertTo); assert on timestamp not blockNumber (warp approximates blocks as seconds/2); harness gasUsed is execution gas only, so it is a regression detector and NOT a price - real cost needs calldata + blob-fee model + testnet.
The harness runs Mainnet/Cancun, so ALL L2 behaviour (force-inclusion, sequencer, L1 fee) is testnet-or-above; a harness-only suite may not gate an L2-dependent promotion.
Zero flake tolerance and no retries at L0-L3 (deterministic by construction); max one logged retry at L4-L6.

Coverage: 100% line+branch on packages/protocol and on the immutable core, justified by ADR-010 (core unfixable in place) and by protocol being the TS-DIFF oracle. Circuits are NOT measured by line coverage - the metric is 100% claims.json negative-test coverage plus a clean circomspect.
Quarterly seeded-defect drill (20 defects, >=90% caught) replaces a mutation-testing tool; no such tool exists in the repo and none was invented.

ZK doctrine: positive tests prove nothing; Z2 negative/malformed-witness tests are mandatory and CI fails when a claim in claims.json has no negative test; circomspect findings >= Warning fail the build; witness generation is differentially tested against packages/protocol; Gate-2 rule that circuit results MUST NOT be presented as evidence of soundness.

Capability-absence testing is first-class: ABI allowlist snapshot (primary), denylist + PUSH4 bytecode selector scan + DELEGATECALL/SELFDESTRUCT opcode scan, storage-layout snapshot, negative-authority matrix, human review checklist - with six stated limits of the technique.
Mock verifiers (MockVerifierAlwaysTrue) are banned from any suite claiming a ZK property.

Guardrail escalation rule: any defect against a guardrail FR or a capability-absence assertion is automatically Sev-1 regardless of user impact, because TD-04 leaves no override to fix the consequence.

Test data: no real personal data in ANY environment including a developer laptop (CON-002), enforced by three build-failing CI scanners with no bypass; production notification/support stores may never be copied downward.
open_items: OPEN-01 (Gate-2 blocking) MACI_VOTING off in staging/prod and deferred to Phase 3 by ADR-006, but FR-031/FR-032/NFR-003 receipt-freeness are Must guardrails - not delivered at v1. Independently reached by the project-manager in Doc 13.
OPEN-02 (Gate-2 blocking) FR-004's 50%-per-region attestor share cap has no implementing mechanism; PersonhoodRegistry has a per-epoch count cap and no region dimension.

OPEN-03 (Gate-2 blocking) FeatureFlags.disable() is unconditional and unilateral; nothing prevents disabling a flag governing an open ballot or blocking execution of a passed proposal - which NFR-020 requires and CON-003 forbids having.
OPEN-04 (Gate-2 blocking) ADR-003 scopes the issuer nullifier per issuer under 1-of-N acceptance, so one human with two accepted credentials enrols twice and votes twice, contradicting FR-001/BR-006.
OPEN-05 (Gate-2 blocking) PersonhoodRegistry.spendNullifier is external with no caller restriction - any address can burn any nullifier and deny a citizen an action.
OPEN-06 (Gate-2 blocking) issuerSetValid() is advisory; enrol() never consults it, so a region can fall to a single state issuer and keep enrolling.
OPEN-07 FR-011's minimum-substance standard is a 280-character length floor, not a substance check (OI-09 open).
OPEN-08 FR-002/NFR-001 'better than chance' is not falsifiable as written; needs an adversary game with epsilon and sample size.
OPEN-09 No named QA Lead in Doc 02's roster; Doc 04 ownership resolves to the architect per CLAUDE.md. Doc 13 subsequently names Ji-woo Park as Test Lead - reconcile at Doc 04 v1.0.1.

OPEN-10 OI-05: Doc 13 records it as design-resolved by ADR-004 s2 (escalate to nearest ancestor meeting k>=1000). That resolves PUBLICATION scope; the open point is that escalation must never apply to ELIGIBILITY, or a ward election's electorate silently changes. TS-ADV-06/A-06.10 tests that boundary.
OPEN-11 (Gate-2 blocking) NFR-025 demands alternative inclusion <= 60 min; ADR-001 states L1 force-inclusion is 12-24 h. Irreconcilable as written.
OPEN-12 RegionRegistry.submitPopulation is onlyTimelock, so 'independent' population sources all arrive through one authority.
OPEN-13 OI-10 collusion bound unset, so NFR-001 has no pass threshold.
OPEN-14 NFR-004's 0.1% duplicate rate is not internally measurable by design; needs an out-of-band consented audited sample with a stated confidence interval.
OPEN-15 NFR-005's median cost per citizen governance action has no enumerated denominator.
OPEN-16 ADR-001 and ADR-002 both cite a non-existent 'ADR-017'; the sponsorship policy lives in ADR-014.
OPEN-17 packages/contracts has no package.json/test workspace although root package.json declares test:contracts - npm run verify silently skips all contract tests today.

OPEN-18 Doc 04 s16 still carries CON-007's Gate-2 date of 2027-02-15; Doc 13 re-bases Gate 2 to 2027-05-14 (MS-13) and is the schedule of record. Doc 04 s16 must be re-based at v1.0.1. Ordering and exit signals are unaffected.
